subject: world_language
concept: Participating in a simulated professional meeting or interview in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'professional interaction' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences professional-interaction phrase cards into a coherent simulated meeting exchange
exercise.abstract: Student performs a simulated professional meeting or interview exchange fluently in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: exchange uses appropriate professional register and responds coherently to realistic prompts
misconception_flags: uses casual/informal register inappropriately within a professional simulated exchange

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
